author: Bijan Mousavi

checks.command: npm run setup; npm run fixture-test; isolated npm run fixture-build -- node|netlify

title: Independent reported candidate verification
why: Fork merges need independent execution tied to the actual head and integration checkout.
what: Add read-only fork checks, original-epoch replay and checkout receipts. Preserve upstream preview checks under their upstream repository identity.
how: Pin tools/actions; replay introduced controls at original trees. Build both adapters in clean independent snapshots and persist every completed process outcome. Query live jobs and their Git identities.
preserved: Inherited application bytes, runtime commands and 986 locked packages retain their identity. Fork preview jobs are explicitly not applicable; no deployment is performed.
risk: Changed application inputs require an extended verified gate contract. Recorded success cannot override missing or failed live jobs.
limitations: 116 tests, both builds and actionlint 1.7.12 pass. Mutation probes reject polluted adapter inputs and altered pages, commands and locks. An unpublished failed replay is retained; committed replay, Actions and review follow authoring.
rollback: Revert workflow and candidate/identity tools together in a reported change. Retain upstream checks and evidence; stop promotion until replacement checks pass.
